features.title: Fix PII scanner column-name hint sensitivity and metadata
acceptance: Column-name-only email detection produces high sensitivity, GDPR/CCPA regulation, and mask_email rule
Column-name-only phone detection produces medium sensitivity with correct regulation and mask
Column-name-only ip_address and date_of_birth detection produce medium sensitivity with correct metadata
Sensitivity never downgrades from high to medium or medium to low when multiple PII types match a column
mask_rule is preserved (first match wins) instead of being overwritten by later patterns

features.title: Expose audit log listing API endpoint
acceptance: GET /api/audit-logs returns paginated audit log items with action, resource_type, user, and details
Authenticated users can list audit log entries
Tests cover retrieval of audit log entries

features.title: Replace deprecated Pydantic v2 .dict() calls with .model_dump()
acceptance: All scorecard.dict() and entity.dict() calls replaced with .model_dump()
No Pydantic deprecation warnings in test output

features.title: Compute schema drift score when audit runs against a baseline dataset
acceptance: POST /api/audits without baseline_schema_dataset_id stores drift_score = 1.0 (unchanged behavior)
POST /api/audits with baseline_schema_dataset_id computes schema stability score and persists it on the audit run
Baseline dataset with a removed column produces drift_score below 1.0 in create and GET responses
POST /api/audits with an unknown baseline_schema_dataset_id returns 404 instead of silently ignoring the field

features.title: Tighten PII value regexes to stop false positives
acceptance: Phone pattern does not match values such as 192.168.1.1.5 or 2020-13-45999
Date-of-birth pattern rejects impossible dates such as 2020-13-45
Existing PII detection tests continue to pass

features.title: Honor main.py audit --schema flag for schema drift reporting
acceptance: main.py audit --schema <file> prints schema stability score against that baseline
